# Amit Kuzi

Software Architect based in Holon, Israel. Building software since 1997.
Open to software engineering and architecture roles.
This host (amitkuzi.github.io) carries the working artifacts — live tools, source repositories,
Agent Skills and seven original printed designs. The writing, case studies and contact details live at
https://amitkuzi.com

The canonical entity record is https://amitkuzi.com/#amit-kuzi — every schema block on this host
points there rather than declaring a competing identity.

## Live tools

- **OneWall** — https://amitkuzi.github.io/OneWall/ — browser-based parametric customizer for
  vase-mode bins/containers and Gridfinity bins and baseplates. OpenSCAD model re-implemented in
  JavaScript, Three.js preview, client-side CSG, export to STL / STEP / 3MF.
  Docs: https://amitkuzi.github.io/OneWall/about.html · Source: https://github.com/amitkuzi/OneWall
- **localViewer** — https://amitkuzi.github.io/localViewer/ — local-first viewer for Markdown,
  YAML, CSV, STL, 3MF, STEP, OpenSCAD and images. Files are parsed in the browser and never
  uploaded. PWA, works offline. Source: https://github.com/amitkuzi/localViewer

## Source repositories

Selected public projects from Amit's GitHub pins are listed in pinned.json. Only reviewed,
non-fork repositories are included; new pins are not added automatically.

## Printed designs

- **Top Hat for Elegoo Centauri Carbon 1 with CANVAS** - https://www.printables.com/model/1900377-top-hat-for-elegoo-centauri-carbon-1-with-canvas
  Original PETG-CF modular top cover with mounting panels and connectors. Includes STL and 3MF files. Original design by Amit Kuzi; Printables license: CC BY 4.0.
  MakerWorld: https://makerworld.com/en/models/3539119-top-hat-for-elegoo-centauri-carbon-1-with-canvas#profileId-4047634
- **Poop Collector for Elegoo Centauri Carbon with CANVAS** - https://www.printables.com/model/1900409-poop-collector-for-elegoo-centauri-carbon-with-can
  Magnetic purge-waste collector. Includes an STL file and the original ElegooSlicer 3MF project. Original design by Amit Kuzi; Printables license: CC BY 4.0.
  MakerWorld: https://makerworld.com/en/models/3539364-canvas-poop-collector-for-elegoo-centauri-carbon

- **OneWall - Vase-Mode Bins + Gridfinity Creator** - https://www.printables.com/model/1785076-onewall-vase-mode-bins-gridfinity-creator-parametr
  Parametric vase-mode bins and containers generated with OneWall. Adjust dimensions and wall textures, then export a printable model. Original design by Amit Kuzi, corroborated by source history and publication records.
  MakerWorld: https://makerworld.com/en/models/2948815-onewall-vase-mode-bin-container-customizer

- **Vacuum Valve for Bag or Container** - https://makerworld.com/en/models/2611095-vacuum-valve-for-bag-or-container
  A printable one-way valve for pulling air out of a storage bag or container. Original design by Amit Kuzi.
- **Helmet Donut (TPU Edition)** - https://makerworld.com/en/models/2584800-helmet-donut-tpu-edition
  A TPU ring that keeps a helmet off the floor and off its shell. Original design by Amit Kuzi.
- **Sleek Under-Desk Headphone Hanger** - https://makerworld.com/en/models/2568791-sleek-under-desk-headphone-hanger
  A low-profile hanger that mounts under a desk edge and keeps headphones off the work surface. Original design by Amit Kuzi.
- **Pour-Over Coffee Glass Stabilizer Ring** - https://makerworld.com/en/models/2494091-pour-over-coffee-glass-stabilizer-ring
  A ring that steadies a pour-over cone on a glass carafe. Original design by Amit Kuzi.

Authorship reviewed on 2026-11-06; Amit Kuzi confirmed authorship of all five earlier designs.
Source and confirmation provenance is recorded in models.json.
